verdict_rationale: The per-entry vocabulary ({disposition, view_tag}) is engine-internal receipt/presentation bookkeeping. It appears nowhere in the cached wiki text under data/ and nowhere in docs/math-foundations.md, so the map's CONTENTS are outside what these two oracle sources can reconstruct. This leaf is, strictly, not fully oracle-checkable from the permitted evidence.

What IS checkable is checked and passes: (a) the cardinality 178 is not an enumeration over any cached roster — no collection of size 178 exists anywhere under data/, which positively excludes the 'one entry per catalogued champion/item/rune/atom' reading and is consistent with the leaf's placement under .../combat/; (b) 178 sits inside the event-count band 146..~200 that the sourced auto cadence (floor(AS·u·T) with Syndra's cached 0.658 base / 0.625 ratio / +2%/level) and the sourced Q/W/E/R cooldowns force for a 120 s fight, and it is reachable by an exact decomposition of those sourced counts.

No quoted wiki value and no quoted formula in docs/math-foundations.md is contradicted by the new map. Conversely, nothing in the permitted evidence justifies the old absence: a golden leaf that is absent asserts nothing and pins nothing, and the engine's combat section demonstrably has events to disposition in this scenario.

Between the three permitted verdicts, 'old_value_correct' would assert the absence was right (unsupported by any source) and 'both_wrong' would assert a defect I found no evidence for. 'new_value_correct' is therefore recorded, with this explicit caveat: it certifies that the new value survives every independent check the permitted sources allow, NOT that a 178-entry {disposition, view_tag} map was recomputed entry-by-entry from wiki text.
recommended_follow_up: If this leaf is meant to be oracle-checkable, the 'disposition' and 'view_tag' vocabularies need a definition in a source the oracle can read (docs/math-foundations.md or a data/ schema, e.g. alongside data/atoms/atoms.schema.json). As of this HEAD an independent investigator can bound the map's size but cannot verify a single entry.
